$sources: EN 1991-1-4:2005 Sec 1.5 (design assisted by testing and measurements); z0 of the terrain categories from the wind table (Table 4.1); see VERIFY.md
source: EN 1991-1-4:2005 Sec 1.5; SAEngine practice for the number of directions and the lower limit
validation: EN 1991-1-4 Sec 1.5 allows wind tunnel tests and properly validated numerical methods, with appropriate models of the structure and of the natural wind. SAEngine does not validate the CFD results: the engineer does.

sources.directionStep: SAEngine practice: 12 directions every 30° (EN 1991-1-4 gives no number of directions for tests)
sources.roughness: None here: the terrain categories' z0 of the wind table (EN 1991-1-4 Table 4.1)
sources.lowerLimit: SAEngine practice after ASCE 7-22 Sec 31.4.3 (EN 1991-1-4 gives no lower limit; a National Annex may)
